metadata.title: JSDR.Configuration
metadata.description: PowerShell module for configuration of NetApp JetStream DR version 5.1.0

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'backup_old_logs' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
